label: puter
title: Puter: LLMs from the browser
description: How to reach language models from a static page with Puter.js: the visitor signs in with their own Puter account and pays their own way. No API key, no backend.
conditions: Facts only from Puter's own documentation; no Puter logo or trade dress; the demo runs only when a visitor signs in with their own account; nothing billed to us.
source: Dinis Cruz, in a.maestro's session, 25 Nov 2026 ~02:37 UTC: "in terms of platforms, I think we should put one for Puter, and I actually think that it's probably worth also doing one for NVIDIA ... the idea is to create these web-based environments where we can access them"; relayed by a.maestro (02:39) and sites.a.
